searchText: Testing call in 1min: https://ethereumfoundation.zoom.us/j/86466169680?pwd=x17cbD1lDCeQEWMTTOLARQhELiJV21.1 sorry I got distracted and I missed this one anything you'd like to share regarding attestation packing? Surfacing PR to set mainnet fork date on the eth-clients repo: https://github.com/eth-clients/mainnet/pull/4 we are still testing several things on the new algo. We most likely release mainnet with an experimental flag to enable a new behaviour. We will change new to be the default on subsequent releases. We are not running any particular analysis on any testnet as a whole.. btw can someone with admin rights protect the master branch of this repo, noticed I can push directly to that branch 😅 added 😄 nothing changed in the last 7 days as far as I can see, we also have some minor improvements in packing for Lodestar, will be part of mainnet release, also have major rework of packing to consider EB but seems to risky to include now, and will mostly be relevant once we have a lot of consolidations on mainnet https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/interop-testing-call-32-april-7-2025/23422
